caption: venus enters capricorn today (14:30 utc) and stays until mar 1. love that shows up on time.

slides.headline: *capricorn*, venus just moved into your sign. until march 1
*venus* leaves sagittarius and steps into capricorn
slides.body: venus moves through capricorn until march 1, so valentine's falls inside it. astrologers read venus as how you love. in capricorn: slow, loyal, a little guarded.

slides.headline: wanting someone isn't a *weakness*
slides.body: you plan everything. plan to say it.

slides.headline: date like you mean to keep it
slides.body: show up when you said you would. that's the romance this month.

slides.headline: your sun is who you are. your *venus* is how you love.
